artifacts.name: pre-tool-use-bash
artifacts.description: Blocks `git commit` when staged files contain secrets or private keys.
artifacts.searchText: What it does Blocks git commit when staged files contain secrets or private keys. Install Runs before every Bash tool call and stops a git commit that would include a secret. It runs automatically once the plugin is installed.

artifacts.searchText: What it does Exposes reviews, findings and agents to Claude through an MCP server. Env vars: DEVDIGESTURL Install Set DEVDIGESTURL to the address of your local DevDigest instance before starting Claude Code.

artifacts.name: devdigest
artifacts.description: DevDigest review workflow for Claude Code: skills, agents, hooks and MCP server
artifacts.searchText: DevDigest review workflow for Claude Code. It connects Claude to a local DevDigest instance and adds skills, agents and hooks for reviewing pull requests. What's inside 3 skills: review, pr-brief, dependency-checker 3 review agents: security, test quality and performance export-ci command that turns an agent into a GitHub Actions workflow pre-tool-use-bash hook that blocks commits containing secrets MCP server that exposes reviews and findings to Claude Requirements Claude Code with plugin support DevDigest running locally, with DEVDIGESTURL pointing to it Quick start

artifacts.name: review
artifacts.description: Reviews a pull request diff and reports findings grouped by severity, with file and line references.
artifacts.searchText: What it does Reads the diff of the current branch against its base and reports findings grouped by severity: blocker, major, minor and nit. Every finding points to a file and line, so you can jump straight to it. When to use Before you request a review on a pull request. After a large refactor, to catch regressions the tests miss. When you inherit a pull request and need to know where the risk is. Usage Without arguments the skill compares HEAD with the merge base of the default branch. Output Severity rules live in references/severity.md. Edit that file to tune what counts as a blocker for your team.

fields: Reviews a pull request diff and reports findings grouped by severity, with file and line references.
